step1_analysis.description: A dual-rail flip-flop or latch sub-circuit designed for low-voltage operation. The netlist appears to contain a pull-down network and a potentially mis-extracted pull-up network (PMOS sources connected to GND).

paper_reference.title: Design Techniques for Single-Low-VDD CMOS Systems

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard nominal voltage for sky130 is 1.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adapted to SKY130 standard core voltage.
SKY130 can easily operate at >100MHz, though the paper targeted 15MHz at an ultra-low 0.5V supply.
Efficiency metrics depend on the full system implementation and architecture.

sky130_expected.calculation: Based on 0.5um channel length and 1.8V supply, delay is dominated by load capacitance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard logic delay in 130nm at 1.8V is very fast, but L=0.5um slows it down slightly.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C * V^2 * f. With C ~ 10fF, V=1.8V, f=15MHz, P ~ 0.5uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic power at 15MHz with minimal load.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure delay, rise/fall times, and average power of the flip-flop.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Flip-Flop Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 N3 N1 GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_0 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N2 GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 GND N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 GND LABEL_NET_1 N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 GND N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 GND GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 GND N0 GND VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 GND N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 pulse(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 33n 66n)
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 pulse(1.8 0 0 100p 100p 33n 66n)
VN1 N1 0 pulse(0 1.8 5n 100p 100p 66n 132n)
VN2 N2 0 pulse(1.8 0 5n 100p 100p 66n 132n)

Cload1 N0 0 1f
Cload2 N4 0 1f

.control
tran 100p 200n
meas tran delay_d_q trig v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran delay_clk_q trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_rise trig v(N0) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=1.44 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(N0) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.36 fall=1
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power
print avg_power
quit
.endc
.end
